subject.title: fix(ollama): models advertise tools when /api/show fails

question: Should failed Ollama `/api/show` inspection intentionally disable advertised tool support for already tag-discovered and setup models, despite transient failures changing existing optimistic behavior?
rationale: Source and proof establish the bug and patch correctness, but choosing conservative accuracy over temporary tool availability changes shipped fallback semantics and requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept conservative inspection failure
options.body: Merge the three-state behavior so actual `/api/show` failures disable tools while successful capability omission remains optimistic.

options.title: Preserve optimistic availability
options.body: Keep tools advertised during failed inspection and accept that broken or uninspectable models can appear tool-capable.

options.title: Use last-known successful metadata
options.body: Retain prior successful capability metadata during transient failures and fall back conservatively only when no successful inspection is available.

recommendation.title: Accept conservative inspection failure
recommendation.body: Merge the three-state behavior so actual `/api/show` failures disable tools while successful capability omission remains optimistic.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the optimistic unknown-capability behavior whose failure boundary is being narrowed.
